schema_version.description: Fixed at 1 for this shape. A consumer built against v1 MUST refuse any other value outright rather than best-effort parse it — same posture as the catalog index's schema_version check.

tenant_id.description: Permanent, immutable once first published — same rule as the catalog index's `slug`. DNS-label-safe (lowercase alphanumeric + hyphen, max 63 chars, no leading/trailing hyphen) because D-Store and Zealot resolve tenants by subdomain, so a tenant_id must always be usable as one even if a given deployment resolves some other way.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601, as the catalog index.

sequence.description: Strictly increasing per publish for this tenant_id. A reader (Storeapp's TenantConfig fetch, 1.c.ii.zi) refuses any sequence lower than its last-cached value for the same tenant_id — anti-rollback, identical mechanism to the catalog index's own `sequence` field, reusing that same verification code path rather than a second implementation.

expires_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 freshness bound. A reader refuses a record past this timestamp and falls back to its last-known-good cached copy — same posture as the catalog index.

display_name.description: In-app display name shown in UI copy (about screen, headers). NOT the launcher/home-screen app name — that's `applicationId`-adjacent, build-time-fixed by Gradle product flavor (1.c.i.zo), and deliberately absent from this schema; see "What's intentionally excluded" below.

logo_sha256.description: Required if logo_url is non-null — a reader should refuse to render a fetched logo whose hash doesn't match, same defensive posture as every other fetched-asset check in this program.

cdn_base.description: Feeds MetadataManager.cdnBase (Storeapp leaf 1.c.ii.zi), replacing today's compile-time constant. The default tenant's value MUST be exactly "https://nikhilkain.github.io/appstore-metadata" — the existing hardcoded string — so default install behavior is provably unchanged by this migration, not just intended to be.

catalog_index_base_url.description: Per-tenant equivalent of today's single ZEALOT_CATALOG_INDEX_BASE_URL env var (D-Store leaf 6.b.ii.zo, Zealot Task 37b). null means this tenant has no first-party Zealot source configured — the Zealot/AppSource.ZEALOT adapter (Storeapp 1.a.i.zo) simply has nothing to fetch, not an error. Deliberately a separate field from cdn_base: cdn_base points at unsigned, unverified upstream data by design (see Storeapp HANDOVER.md's superseded "No CDN migration" note); this field points at a signed, Ed25519-verified index. Conflating the two would blur a real trust-boundary difference.

domains.description: Domains/subdomains that resolve to this tenant at the D-Store/Zealot middleware layer (D-Store 6.b.ii.zi, Zealot Task 37b). Empty for a tenant not yet live on the web tier (e.g. an Android-only white-label spin-off) — not an error.

is_default_tenant.description: True for exactly one record: the seed tenant whose values reproduce today's pre-multi-tenant hardcoded behavior (cdn_base = the existing nikhilkain URL, branding = "Vyxel Apps"). Exists so a consumer can assert at least one such record is always present, never so every tenant with this shape is trusted equally — trust comes from the signature check (1.c.ii.zo), not this flag.
